have zip_fst :
      ∀ (as : List P.Ident) (bs : List P.Expr),
        as.length = bs.length →
        List.map Prod.fst (as.zip bs) = as := by
    intro as
    induction as with
    | nil =>
      intro bs _
      simp
    | cons a as ih =>
      intro bs H
      cases bs with
      | nil => simp at H
      | cons b bs =>
        simp at H
        simp [ih bs H]

records.source_text:
have zip_fst :
      ∀ (as : List P.Ident) (bs : List P.Expr),
        as.length = bs.length →
        List.map Prod.fst (as.zip bs) = as := by
    intro as
    induction as with
    | nil =>
      intro bs _
      simp
    | cons a as ih =>
      intro bs H
      cases bs with
      | nil => simp at H
      | cons b bs =>
        simp at H
        simp [ih bs H]

induction as with
    | nil =>
      intro bs _
      simp
    | cons a as ih =>
      intro bs H
      cases bs with
      | nil => simp at H
      | cons b bs =>
        simp at H
        simp [ih bs H]
